The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
dialogues.text: Nobody disputes the position that Mequignon and her Bertin's House of Curiosities holds in Fontaine's fashion industry. One could say that it is in fact she who defines "fashion" in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
dialogues.text: When reporters asked her about her innovative conceptions, she responded: "My inspiration comes from those ancient things forgotten by others. For only that which has been completely forgotten can be completely new."

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird Culture and Arts Section
